caption: The drawing depicts a single, central vase composed of shades of purple and pink, with distinct elongated oval shapes forming a pattern around its body. The vase has a wide, round opening at the top with a thick rim, narrowing at the neck and then expanding towards the base. The base gradually tapers and ends with a flat bottom. There are darker purple outlines that define the contours and decorative segments of the vase. The surface on which the vase stands has a light green tint, with a reflection of the vase visible below. The background is plain and off-white, with no additional objects or details.
title: Vase
